articles.title: Lindsay Clancy judge refuses to dismiss murder charge against killer mom - and bans her lawyer from investigating holdout juror
articles.summary: Judge William Sullivan, in a memorandum of decision filed Monday, denied Lindsay Clancy's motion to dismiss the murder charges on double jeopardy grounds.

articles.title: Judge Denies Request to Throw Out Lindsay Clancy’s Murder Charges
articles.summary: The judge also declined to investigate the lone juror who wanted to convict Ms. Clancy, saying it would invade his privacy and deter others from serving on juries.

articles.title: 'No evidence' Polish killer was far-Right, prosecutors admit as it is revealed he executed parents and sister with two shots to the head each as they slept… and even killed their two cats
articles.summary: Polish prosecutors say there is no evidence that a gunman who allegedly killed six people in central Krakow after shooting his parents and sister at home was linked to the far-Right.

articles.title: Parents, sister of far-right Kraków shooter found dead in family home
articles.summary: Three bodies found in the home of the 24-year-old shooter in Saturday’s rampage in the heart of Kraków, Poland, belonged to the gunman’s family, police said.
